fact_text: Select Technologies, a subsidiary of Airlink, offers about 88 million shares in an IPO whose book building opens on Monday, 22 Jun 2026.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Select Technologies IPO | Rs 28 Floor & Rs 42 Strike | SCS Trade IPO Analysis' (YouTube, 2026-06-20)

fact_text: The IPO has a floor price of Rs 28 per share.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Select Technologies IPO | Rs 28 Floor & Rs 42 Strike | SCS Trade IPO Analysis' (YouTube, 2026-06-20)

fact_text: The IPO has a strike price of Rs 42 per share.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Select Technologies IPO | Rs 28 Floor & Rs 42 Strike | SCS Trade IPO Analysis' (YouTube, 2026-06-20)

fact_text: The shares have a face value of Rs 10 each.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Select Technologies IPO | Rs 28 Floor & Rs 42 Strike | SCS Trade IPO Analysis' (YouTube, 2026-06-20)

fact_text: About 75% of the offer goes to book building and 25% to the electronic IPO (EIPO) tranche.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Select Technologies IPO | Rs 28 Floor & Rs 42 Strike | SCS Trade IPO Analysis' (YouTube, 2026-06-20)

fact_text: If EIPO demand exceeds 5 times, the split moves to 70% book building and 30% EIPO; above 10 times, the EIPO share rises to 35% of the offer.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Select Technologies IPO | Rs 28 Floor & Rs 42 Strike | SCS Trade IPO Analysis' (YouTube, 2026-06-20)

fact_text: At the Rs 28 floor price the offer would raise about PKR 2.49 billion.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Select Technologies IPO | Rs 28 Floor & Rs 42 Strike | SCS Trade IPO Analysis' (YouTube, 2026-06-20)

fact_text: At the Rs 42 strike price the offer would raise about PKR 3.73 billion.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Select Technologies IPO | Rs 28 Floor & Rs 42 Strike | SCS Trade IPO Analysis' (YouTube, 2026-06-20)

fact_text: About 43% of IPO proceeds, roughly PKR 1 billion, goes into working capital.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Select Technologies IPO | Rs 28 Floor & Rs 42 Strike | SCS Trade IPO Analysis' (YouTube, 2026-06-20)

fact_text: 15% of IPO proceeds goes to capital injection into the TV assembly line.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Select Technologies IPO | Rs 28 Floor & Rs 42 Strike | SCS Trade IPO Analysis' (YouTube, 2026-06-20)

fact_text: 17% of IPO proceeds, about PKR 433 million, goes to the smartphone plant.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Select Technologies IPO | Rs 28 Floor & Rs 42 Strike | SCS Trade IPO Analysis' (YouTube, 2026-06-20)

fact_text: 25% of IPO proceeds goes to the AC assembly plant and machinery.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Select Technologies IPO | Rs 28 Floor & Rs 42 Strike | SCS Trade IPO Analysis' (YouTube, 2026-06-20)

fact_text: The smartphone plant at Quaid-e-Azam Industrial Estate has annual capacity of about 3.5 million units.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Select Technologies IPO | Rs 28 Floor & Rs 42 Strike | SCS Trade IPO Analysis' (YouTube, 2026-06-20)

fact_text: Smartphone capacity utilisation at the Quaid-e-Azam Industrial Estate plant is about 58%, while TV utilisation is about 5%.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Select Technologies IPO | Rs 28 Floor & Rs 42 Strike | SCS Trade IPO Analysis' (YouTube, 2026-06-20)

fact_text: The planned smartphone capacity in the Special Economic Zone at Sundar is about 7 million units a year.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Select Technologies IPO | Rs 28 Floor & Rs 42 Strike | SCS Trade IPO Analysis' (YouTube, 2026-06-20)

fact_text: The company holds about 2.6% of the AC market.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Select Technologies IPO | Rs 28 Floor & Rs 42 Strike | SCS Trade IPO Analysis' (YouTube, 2026-06-20)

fact_text: The company holds about 9% of the mobile phone market.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Select Technologies IPO | Rs 28 Floor & Rs 42 Strike | SCS Trade IPO Analysis' (YouTube, 2026-06-20)

fact_text: The company gets a tax benefit until 2035 because its plants sit in a Special Economic Zone.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Select Technologies IPO | Rs 28 Floor & Rs 42 Strike | SCS Trade IPO Analysis' (YouTube, 2026-06-20)

fact_text: Select Technologies is a business-to-business contract manufacturer that assembles phones, AC units and TVs for brands and does not sell to consumers directly.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Select Technologies IPO | Rs 28 Floor & Rs 42 Strike | SCS Trade IPO Analysis' (YouTube, 2026-06-20)

fact_text: Its two global partners are Xiaomi (Hong Kong) and Hisense, for which it makes products under contract.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Select Technologies IPO | Rs 28 Floor & Rs 42 Strike | SCS Trade IPO Analysis' (YouTube, 2026-06-20)

fact_text: The company says it sells about 99% of its products directly to Xiaomi.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Select Technologies IPO | Rs 28 Floor & Rs 42 Strike | SCS Trade IPO Analysis' (YouTube, 2026-06-20)

fact_text: Mobile phone kits are imported as semi-knocked-down (SKD) kits and assembled at the company's plant.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Select Technologies IPO | Rs 28 Floor & Rs 42 Strike | SCS Trade IPO Analysis' (YouTube, 2026-06-20)

fact_text: The company says Al Hilal Advisers certified its business as Shariah compliant.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Select Technologies IPO | Rs 28 Floor & Rs 42 Strike | SCS Trade IPO Analysis' (YouTube, 2026-06-20)

fact_text: The analyst said borrowings of about PKR 12 billion against equity of PKR 12.1 billion make leverage high, and equity would be about PKR 16 billion after the IPO.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Select Technologies IPO | Rs 28 Floor & Rs 42 Strike | SCS Trade IPO Analysis' (YouTube, 2026-06-20)

fact_text: The analyst expected IPO demand to be lower than for earlier listings because leverage is higher and working capital needs funding; he urged reading the prospectus.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Select Technologies IPO | Rs 28 Floor & Rs 42 Strike | SCS Trade IPO Analysis' (YouTube, 2026-06-20)

fact_text: The analyst valued the company on forward price-to-earnings ratios, using forward earnings as the basis.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Select Technologies IPO | Rs 28 Floor & Rs 42 Strike | SCS Trade IPO Analysis' (YouTube, 2026-06-20)

fact_text: The analyst said Xiaomi's Chinese origin gives Select Technologies an edge over the Samsung assembly run by a listed peer.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Select Technologies IPO | Rs 28 Floor & Rs 42 Strike | SCS Trade IPO Analysis' (YouTube, 2026-06-20)
